definitions.explanation: The ordinary, polite-enough way to refer to a woman in everyday speech, especially one whose name you do not know.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{女|おんな}の{人|ひと}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please ask the woman at the reception desk.
A woman I didn't know asked me the way at the station.

notes:
The counterpart of ⟦{男|おとこ}の{人|ひと}→男の人：00337_otokonohito⟧ (man). It is what a speaker says in conversation when pointing someone out or describing a person.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧: woman, female — more formal; used in writing, news and on signs
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧: lady — more polite, used about a customer or a stranger in a respectful setting
- ⟦{女|おんな}→女：00559_onna⟧: woman — blunt; said about a particular person it can sound rude or contemptuous
- ⟦{女|おんな}の{子|こ}→女の子：02865_onnanoko⟧: girl; in casual speech also a young woman
